title: Reader submissions: extraction step (model, maker, task) and a read API for the Submit page
description:
Requested by the Shipped session for Ryan ("Yes, do both", 2026-10-31). Planning, no rush ahead of the Shipped console move.

Goal: after a reader submits a link (reader-steering submit-a-link), an extraction step pulls out the model, maker and task the submission is about, matches it to References and entities, and exposes the result through a read API so the Submit page can show "Confirm what the map pulled out" for the reader to confirm.

docs/reader-steering.md: "a later extraction step is where a submission meets References and entities". Build that step and its read API (reader-scoped: a reader reads only their own submission's extraction; no identity in public output).

Consumer: Shipped-web Submit page (currently a placeholder).

Acceptance: Gherkin for submit, then extraction, then the reader reads and confirms; moderation and privacy rules as in reader-steering; docs.
